findings.how: Reproduced with a Chromium forced-colours probe over every window, dark and light (scratchpad/fx-css/forced-probe.mjs): 104 of 114 checks failed. ember.css got a forced-colours block. It maps the tokens to system colours (the accent becomes Highlight; the state colours become CanvasText or GrayText) and gives .btn a ButtonText border, with the prominent button filled with Highlight. Switches and checkboxes are drawn as they are (forced-color-adjust: none) in system colours. Focus is `outline: 2px solid Highlight !important; outline-offset: 2px` on :focus-visible, except on programmatic headings. Each page's styles.css and BUBBLE_CSS got its own block: borders on cards, Start, pop-ups, fields, tabs, the command block, task and bubble buttons, and desk buttons. The slider track and thumb and the fold chevrons use system colours, the chosen character gets a 3 px Highlight border, and the selected tab is Highlight-filled. Controls filled with Highlight use forced-color-adjust: none, because the system's text backplate hid their words. After the fix 108 of 114 checks pass. The other 6 are probe artefacts, each confirmed in screenshots: a checked switch shows its state by its fill, the slider's edge is on its track pseudo-element, and the Ask glyph is decorative.

final.notes:
Round 2 resumed from a paused run. Six round-2 commits were already in place (9533f05, f86d159, ea34e2d, 1a6c577, 84312e3, 2e52d11), plus one uncommitted edit identical to docs/release-review/wip/css.patch. I checked that edit and committed it as 672740e: it keeps announce() in handle/main.ts, so fix/bubble's change to the announcement line merges. I also found and fixed one more gap the verifier didn't name (14d1cae): a text size chosen after the command or prompt window had been made never reached that window until a restart, because the controllers keep their window. All seven verifier problems are addressed:
- #57 windows and pill: 84312e3, 1a6c577 and 14d1cae.
- #59 'Microphone off' twice: 9533f05 and 672740e.
- #73 repeats at each retry: 9533f05.
- Settings hint: ea34e2d.
- DEVELOPING.md: ea34e2d.
- The @media guard: f86d159.

Merge guidance for the lead:
(1) fix/prompt, windows.ts. Keep fix/prompt's signature, useContentSize, fit and takeKeyboard. Size the constructor with `...forText({ width: PROMPT_SIZE.card.width, height: PROMPT_SIZE.card.height })`. Keep `sizeForText(win, null);` right after the constructor. In `fit`, scale the page size first: `const want = forText(size);`, then pass `want.width + frame.width, want.height + frame.height` to fitBounds. With fix/cmdwin also merged: `return Object.assign(win, { fit, takeKeyboard }, placeable(win));`. In main.ts, the windows import is the union.
(2) fix/cmdwin: only the windows.ts import lines conflict (union). A scratch merge with its tip 9011512 built, and Allow and Not now were on top at every size.
(3) fix/bubble: in bubble.ts, take their :is(attention, error) selector with `max-height: 10lh`. In handle/main.ts, keep this branch's announce(b, status, micNews) and add `where: b.where, step: b.step` to its announcement() call.
(4) fix/overlay: handle/main.ts gets two different `idleLine` imports, theirs from ../overlay/stack (idle, tasks) and this one from ../../shared/mic (idle, mic). Import theirs under another name, e.g. busyIdle, then: `const idle = idleLine(s.idle, s.mic); const line = idle === \"Ready\" ? (busyIdle(s.idle, s.tasks) ?? idle) : idle;`. That keeps Copilot's reason first, then a microphone problem, then the tasks' count. Use it in both the pill's line and cardText.
(5) fix/wslg-rail isn't based on 1b39bb3, so its apparent removals in the handle are base content it lacks, not a conflict with this package.

Still open and not in this package: the terminal's 13 px type (proposal in #57, needs fix/cmdwin's terminal files) and cmdwin's #265 sticky row, which keeps Allow in view at every size, including Default on this branch alone. verifierProblems.fix: Choose one. (a) Widen the pill with the scale: in app/main/handle.ts set the pill to { width: Math.round(200 * scale), height: 56 } and pass the scale in from main's settings.onChange. (b) Keep the pill's type fixed, as for the Ask box, and scale only the no-compositor card: have main pass the handle's mode to page-prefs, or scope handle/styles.css's html[data-text-size] rules to body.fallback and set data-text-size on the handle only while fallback is on. Note that overriding --text-scale on body does not work, because the --type-* tokens are already resolved on :root. Then correct the report and the Settings hint.

verifierProblems.what: In the no-compositor card, muting the microphone with the shortcut or the menu now says 'Microphone off' twice. First the voice state changes to muted, and micAnnouncement() writes 'Microphone off' to #live. Then toggleMute's setStatus('mic', 'Microphone off') arrives as a second update, and announce() pushes the changed status, rewriting #live with the same words. A DOM probe confirmed it: in card mode the live region changed to 'Microphone off' on both updates; in pill mode only once (vmic.mjs in the scratchpad folder).
verifierProblems.fix: In app/renderer/handle/main.ts announce(), keep the last mic news that was said (e.g. `lastMicNews`). When the status changes to exactly that text, update announcedStatus but do not push it again. Alternatively, skip micNews when it equals `status ?? announcedStatus`. Add a handle-mic test that runs announce() twice in the order main sends the updates.

verifierProblems.what: 'Microphone problem' is said again on every retry while listening is broken. In VoiceService.restartLater, after a voice-process crash, a lost mic page or no sound, the state cycles error → starting → error at 1 s, 5 s, then every 30 s. The handle treats every move back into error as news, because lastMic was 'starting'. The DOM probe shows a new live announcement on each 'error again', in pill and card mode alike, so a screen reader hears it about every 30 s indefinitely.
verifierProblems.fix: In handle/main.ts, treat 'starting' and 'downloading' as passing states: keep the last announced mic state through them and reset it only on waiting, active, off or muted. Then error → starting → error is said once, and error → waiting → error is said again. Cover both orders in handle-mic.test.ts.

verifierProblems.what: Weak guard: page-prefs.test.ts "grows every literal font size too" never checks rules inside an @media block. Its regex captures '@media (...) ' as the selector, and the `!/^\s*@/` filter then drops it. A future px font size inside a media query would pass unscaled; home's `.jump a` at min-width 640 px is covered today only because a twin was written by hand.
verifierProblems.fix: Remove the @media wrappers before matching, e.g. replace /@media[^{]*\{([\s\S]*?\})\s*\}/g with '$1' over the comment-stripped CSS, or walk nested braces. Then check twins for nested rules too.
